title: I asked Astra to build an NFS-inspired Delhi racer starring the Mahindra XEV 9e. Here's the playable prototype.
author: 2600th
selftext:
Astra handled Blender modelling, the city and game systems, with licensed supporting assets. The Three.js/WebGL2 prototype has nearly 16 km of Delhi-inspired roads, traffic, drifting and boost.

It feels unlike earlier models I've used. I could delegate broader tasks when I supplied clear references and specific feedback from the running game.

I'm still figuring out how to tame that capability. This is where the experiment landed.

The video is an edited in-engine reel.

Play Delhi Afterhours: [https://delhi-afterhours-astra.vercel.app/](https://delhi-afterhours-astra.vercel.app/)

What would you improve first?

replies.author: 2600th
replies.body: My bad, can you try now!

comments.author: witmann_pl
comments.body: There's not nearly enough traffic for this to be a realistic depiction of Delhi ;)

replies.author: 2600th
replies.body: Full Delhi traffic would make this a parking simulator. I was aiming for a racer 😂

comments.author: DocHolidayPhD
comments.body: This isn't a playable prototype if it doesn't give people the feeling of playing the game..if your game is this slow and unturned, no one is going to want to play it. What you have is MAYBE a visual approximation of what you would like to build.

replies.author: 2600th
replies.body: You not wanting to play it and it not being playable are two different things.

comments.author: MessageSelfdestructs
comments.body: There's not enough traffic and not enough trash and shit besides the road for this to be a realistic depiction of Delhi...

replies.author: 2600th
replies.body: I left out the roadside trash. You’ve done your bit in the comments.
